name: Doctor Jest
description: An entity grafted into Tezzeret's nervous system by Bolas to compel him.

description_citations.text: "Test of Metal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas regenerates Tezzeret and sets him to find Crucius and etherium's secret, forcing compliance with Doctor Jest in his nervous system.
timeline.quote: Bolas grafted an entity named Doctor Jest into Tezzeret's nervous system, and so Tezzeret is forced to comply.

citation.text: "Test of Metal", section "Plot summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Doctor Jest, thought dead, reveals himself alive and forces Tezzeret to go to Mirrodin on Bolas's orders.
